objective: Determine whether the layer-63 expert-164 activation-weighted rank-four down correction improves GLM-5.2 forward KLD on document-disjoint public references.
evidence_boundary: Expert 164 was selected only from held-out routed-output reconstruction error before any layer-63 model-KLD result was available. The public reference set contains sixteen 512-token documents and supplies an auxiliary mechanism screen, not the registered thirty-two-document checkpoint qualification.

selection_reason.rule: Freeze the one layer-63 expert with a materially larger held-out reconstruction gain than every other expert in the error-blind eight-expert panel.

base_representation.description: K3 gate and up encodes plus the reconstructed-activation down-refit policy, with the input down projection retained wherever that refit did not pass its local selection rule

confirmation_contract.candidate_changes_after_registration: Any change to the layer, expert, rank, dtype, ridge, factor hashes, base representation, or bolt-on construction creates a different candidate.
confirmation_contract.quality_decision: Advance only if paired mean KLD improves and the document-level tail report does not show material harm.
